title: WebHaptics brings native-feeling vibration directly to the mobile web Supports React, Vue and Svelte

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Building mobile web apps or PWAs and missing that satisfying native tap feedback. Web haptics brings native feeling vibration directly to the mobile web. Supports react view and spelt out of the box.
